content: Because you are alive, everything is possible.
author: Thich Nhat Hanh
sourceWork: Thich Nhat Hanh's Essays & Philosophical Writings
story:
This insight touches directly on the messy reality of human nature. Most human unhappiness exists in two places that don't currently exist: the past, which cannot be changed, and the future, which hasn't happened yet. Meanwhile, the only life you will ever experience is slipping past unnoticed.

In Thich Nhat Hanh's view, genuine strength is not an abstract theory—it is a lived, daily practice. Presence is not a rare mystical achievement; it is simply having the courtesy to show up for your own life. When you anchor your awareness in the immediate room and task, the frantic anxieties of the ego dissolve.
reflectionPrompt: Where can you bring full, undistracted presence into an ordinary routine or conversation today?
